observed_value: cost_currency values CAD/EUR/GBP on 13 flagged rows
anchor_value: SOI layout shows CAD/EUR/GBP in Par Amount / Units column, while Cost (3) and Fair Value are separate valuation columns denominated in dollars

findings.detail: Foreign currency tokens such as CAD, EUR, and GBP were assigned to cost_currency even though the source places them under Par Amount / Units, not Cost (3).

rationale: FX03 is a real row-level data error. The flagged non-USD values are present in the raw schedule, but grid evidence shows they occupy the Par Amount / Units column. The adjacent Cost (3) and Fair Value columns are separate valuation columns, with schedule totals displayed with dollar signs, so storing CAD/EUR/GBP as cost_currency is a localized extraction/column mapping defect rather than a valid non-USD cost.
